market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have finished 2nd in two straight EPL seasons (2022-23 and 2023-24) with a young, improving squad under Mikel Arteta. They are expected to be title contenders again in 2025-26, and although the 'exactly 2nd' outcome is narrow, their consistency gives them a ~22% chance, which is higher than the market's implied 16.5%.
evidence_points: Arsenal finished 2nd in the 2022-23 EPL season.
Arsenal finished 2nd again in the 2023-24 EPL season.
They retain a strong core of players and a stable managerial setup, reinforcing their top-tier status.
